item.title: Said & Checked, Washington, 2026-11-19: none false or contradicted, 1 unsettled (Emily Randall)
item.description:
No statement was found false or contradicted.

Unsettled

  • Emily Randall, U.S. Representative from Washington: “People have messaged me asking if Bernie Sanders could be the speaker of the House” Unsettled. The only record of the messages is Randall's own account as reported by PBS NewsHour, which says she was watching direct messages about the leadership election arrive on Instagram. No independent record (her posts, or reporting that saw the messages) was found; her social media accounts were not searched.
